judge.rationale: The primary Node 14 hypotheses strongly agree on HNRNPA2B1-mediated RNA processing, RPLP0-linked translational capacity, TUBB4B-associated mitotic machinery, and PTMA’s proliferation/chromatin context, with the main difference being the additional MYC-centered mechanism in Answers B and C, so roughly three-quarters or more of the molecular content is shared and no ceiling applies.
